maria: heads up — getting customer ticket about a burst of 502s hitting hostedapi around 12:03 UTC. multiple tenants, short spike ~90s.
jamal: any traces or sample reqs? which edge region?
maria: eu1 primarily. stack traces attached in ticket but here's a quick curl that reproduces locally against their payload:
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"inputs": ["a" * 12000]}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
maria: response is a 502 with upstream reset, no body. trace-id x-trace=tr-0a1b2c3d
ian: checking envoy logs — seeing `upstream response error` + `RST_STREAM` from midproxy pool; connection-window exhaustion on h2 streams for a few hosts. also a handful of `HTTP/2: FLOW_CONTROL_ERROR` entries.
jamal: that matches earlier keepalive/conn-window issues. any pattern on request size or concurrency?
maria: customer was sending large batched embeddings (50 items), concurrency ~8 per client. single request body ~1.2MB.
jamal: ok — large payloads + sustained concurrency likely drove h2 flow control to stall, envoy returned 502 to client. can you paste the exact trace id and the proxy pod names?
maria: trace-id tr-0a1b2c3d, proxy pod eu1-mid-7f8c (logs: `envoy upstream reset: code=REFUSED_STREAM`), also eu1-front-2a3b noted `stream window exceeded`
ian: temporary mitigation: increase h2 connection window and lower max concurrent streams on midproxy to reduce thundering. also enable prefix KV caching for embeddings to reduce payload sizes.
jamal: quick workaround for support: ask customer to shard batch sizes to 8 and add client-side exponential backoff + jitter. also we can enable per-tenant routing to eu1-fallback pool with different keepalive settings.
ops-bot: incident created: INC-2026-247 — priority P2.
dev-ryan: I'll push a small canary to eu1 that raises `http2_connection_window` from 65535 -> 262144 and sets `max_concurrent_streams` to 64 on midproxy. will monitor.
ian: also add a short-term L7 retry rule (idempotent POSTs only when client opts-in) with 200ms base backoff to hide intermittent resets. longer-term: autoscale midproxy pool by queue length threshold.
maria: filed customer reply with repro steps + suggested client mitigations. they confirmed they can shard and test.
jamal: can you capture a full tcpdump + envoy traces for the 502 window? need to check if there were any auth handshake delays causing backpressure.
maria: captured and uploaded pcap + envoy access logs to /internal/support/1769554321/ — auth service shows 200s for 0.3% of requests during spike, but majority were fast. not likely primary.
dev-ryan: canary pushed -> eu1 canary id eu1-canary-32. metrics: initial drop in 502 rate for the canary'd tenants.
ian: good sign. I'll open an eng task to: 1) add adaptive h2 window sizing by observed RTT+payload, 2) surface per-tenant concurrency in console, 3) add runaway batch detector.
maria: logging note — include `x-trace` header in future curl samples; it correlates across proxies.
jamal: documenting runbook steps for support: 1) ask customer to reduce batch size 2) enable routing to fallback pool 3) request pcap + envoy logs 4) escalate to eng if >5% error rate for >5m.
maria: customer applied shard -> errors dropped to baseline. will keep monitoring for 2h then close ticket. thx all :thumbsup:
ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary eu1-canary-32 succeeded at 2026-03-19T12:08:13Z
maria: closing the thread for now, will reopen if recurrence.
